name: Old Quillon Burinsnout
description: Everything is shaded with swelling parallel lines, as on old banknotes. Says he dislikes curves, draws them anyway.

designs.title: Sperm Whale
designs.description: A whale in banknote lines, heavy on the belly, blowing over three wavering lines of sea.

designs.title: Alpine Range
designs.description: Three peaks with engraved shadow faces and white caps, and a rayed sun behind them.

designs.title: Lighthouse
designs.description: A banded tower on a rock, its two beams ruled out across the dark. For the ones who stayed ashore.

designs.title: Engraved Moon
designs.description: A full cratered moon in curving lines that swell into its shadow, ringed by small stars.

designs.title: Bronze Bell
designs.description: A ship's bell shaded like a coin, mid-swing, with its clapper showing below the lip.

designs.title: Windfall Pear
designs.description: One heavy pear and one leaf, shaded only with line. Humble subject, a lot of patience.
